caption: The drawing depicts two objects positioned side by side against a plain, cream-colored background. Both objects are shaped like birds perched on rectangular bases and are rendered in shades of brown and dark bronze, with intricate detailing that highlights the feathers and facial features. The bird on the left appears solid and whole, sitting upright with a long, curved tail extending behind it on its base. The bird on the right is depicted in a mechanical, open state, showing internal gears, a spring, and levers, while still maintaining the bird-like shape. The right bird’s tail is also elongated and curves upward, and its beak is open, revealing a serrated edge and more interior mechanism. Both objects are oriented to face each other, and their bases rest parallel to the lower edge of the image. There is a small signature in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Nutcracker
